Taste of Heaven is a restaurant that perfectly blends traditional Italian cuisine with a unique and modern twist. As you enter the restaurant, you are greeted by an inviting aroma, and the soft lighting casts a warm and inviting glow on the spacious dining room. As you take your place at your table, you notice the comfortable yet tasteful decor, including tasteful artwork and beautiful wooden furniture, giving the impression of an elegant, intimate setting. 

Main Courses 

The first dish we ordered was the Rigatoni alla vodka. This pasta was cooked to perfection, with the noodles perfectly cooked and the sauce rich and creamy. The addition of the vodka added a nice depth of flavor and flavor to the pasta, which was accompanied by an equally perfect Parmesan cheese and tomato sauce. The flavor combination was spot-on as was the presentation of the dish. This was definitely one of the highlights of the meal. 

Another appetizer was the Caprese Salad (also using the vodka) which was a light and refreshing tomato salad topped with fresh mozzarella and basil. The flavors were perfectly balanced and had a nice crispness to it. This was another great combination and I would definitely recommend it. 

As for main courses, the Ribollita was another standout dish. My partner and I both loved the hearty but light pasta dish. Made with kale, white beans, and bread crumbs, the pasta was not too heavy on the stomach and the texture of the dish was nice and crisp. The flavor of the dish was very earthy due to the combination of kale, but it still had a nice bite to it. We also enjoyed the addition of olives, onions, and roasted tomatoes, which were also used to top the pasta. The tomato sauce was made with a blend of extra virgin olive oil, tomato paste and tomato sauce, the richness of the sauce was also nicely complemented with a light hint of vinegar, which made it more appealing. We were very pleased with the final flavor of the Ribollita and were really glad we chose it to be the main course of our meal. 
 
To end our meal we both opted for the Tiramisu. This dessert was made with cream, ladyfingers, mascarpone and espresso. Although it lacked a little that was missing from our favourite Italian dessert, the creamy texture of the ladyfingers added an excellent contrast to the creamy mascarpone. It looked beautiful and the taste was extremely pleasant. 

Overall Taste of Heaven is a great Italian restaurant and I would highly recommend visiting. I was really pleased with my meal, and the quality of service was excellent. I can't wait to go back and try their pizza as well, which will be a perfect ending to my meal. I recommend this restaurant to everyone and it would definitely be one of my favorite restaurants in the area. There are many other great Italian restaurants in the area, but Taste of Heaven stands out as one of the best. If you're ever in the area and looking for an Italian restaurant to eat at, I would definitely recommend tasting this one’s food. It's definitely one of the best Italian food places that I've ever been to.
